subject: Air freight quote to DEL
body:
Hello,

Our buyer in Delhi is importing electronic control units from us in Germany, and we are arranging the air freight for their import. Could you please quote your cheapest option for this import shipment to DEL (Delhi, IN)?

The goods will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-28 at our site in 24983 (Kiel), Germany. Please arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport and include it in your all-in price in EUR.

The shipment consists of 11 pieces, with a gross weight of 1619 kg and a volume of 7.66 cbm.

Thank you for your quotation.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH
